description: Approved three-review correction: delete Web.Adapter and declare consumed adapter callbacks in WebBridge; move adapter resolution/runtime/infrastructure calls out of base Bridge; CommunicationBridge owns startup capability routing, WebBridge owns adapter option assembly, supervisor starts returned specs only. Reuse existing provider_config, CommunicationBridge dispatch conventions and OTP lifecycle/rollback; these are local-only transport lifecycle contracts, not business Actions or agent tools. Tests first: domain routing, unchanged options through supervisor, WebBridge override precedence, absent capabilities and two adapters; preserve real public HostAdapter/recovery tests. ZAQ changes remain uncommitted; pinned upstream090f249 unchanged.
title: [zaq-yx7] Keep adapter construction inside WebBridge
